T.note: Technical pair sammuti/paramattha first in Kv; systematized in commentaries (Mp, Vism) and the Manual's ch.1.

CE.note: Term cetasika is Abhidhamma; the lists of 52 are Dhs plus Aṭṭhasālinī synthesis.

CI.note: Numbers 89/121 are Abhidhamma/commentarial counting of Dhs.

RU.note: Count of 28, kalāpa and 4 origins of matter are mostly Abhidhamma/commentarial.

NB.note: Ud 1.10 (Bāhiya) is about direct knowing, not Nibbāna as such; use Ud 8.1-4.

BH.note: Mainly post-canonical: Paṭṭhāna seeds, then Milindapañha and Atthasālinī.

PR.note: The 17-moment vīthi is commentarial (Vism, Aṭṭhasālinī, Sangaha), not canonical.

JV.note: Term javana as a technical stage: commentarial; absent in suttas.

CO.note: Paṭṭhāna is canonical; mapping to atlas fine.

DO.note: Three-lives reading is commentarial; texts show variants.

PL.note: 31 count is a later synthesis; no single sutta lists 31.
